{{Quote|The Brotherhood of Darkness was nothing but a twisted perversion of the Jedi Order, a dark parody of the very thing we stood against.|Darth Bane|<ref name="Darth Bane: Rule of Two">''[[Darth Bane: Rule of Two]]''</ref>}}
The '''Brotherhood of Darkness''', known also as the '''Dark Army''', was a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Army/Legends|army]] that rose to power in the last decade of the [[Republic Dark Age]]. Founded by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]]&ndash;turned&ndash;[[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Skere Kaan]], the Brotherhood was formed out of the fragmented [[New Sith]] after slaughtering many of its most powerful lords and sought to destroy the shattered [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The Brotherhood existed under the leadership of the [[Sith Council (Brotherhood of Darkness)|Sith Council]], constantly warring with the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order's]] [[Army of Light/Legends|Army of Light]] until the [[Seventh Battle of Ruusan]], where they were deceived into destruction by [[Darth Bane/Legends|one of their own]], who then replaced the Brotherhood with the [[Order of the Sith Lords]] and the [[Rule of Two/Legends|Rule of Two]].

==Description==
===Organization and structure===
{{Quote|Aren't we all equal in the Brotherhood of Darkness?|[[Kopecz]]|<ref name="Star Wars: Jedi vs. Sith">''[[Star Wars: Jedi vs. Sith]]''</ref>}}
Created by Dark Lord of the Sith Skere Kaan, the Brotherhood of Darkness was created to replace the failing structure of the former New Sith Empire, which had fought against the Jedi and Republic for centuries before declining. Where feudal warlords waged wars across the galaxy, Kaan sought to organize the Sith into a single army capable of destroying the Jedi and the Republic in short order and finally ending the war. To accomplish this, Kaan appointed his rivals and closest allies as Dark Lords and assembled a [[Sith Council (Brotherhood of Darkness)|Sith Council]] to direct the movements of the army and train new Sith in the ways of the dark side of the Force.<ref name="PoD" />

In addition to this makeshift Council, the Brotherhood leadership afforded the title of [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] to a number of other high-ranking Sith who were tasked with leading the armies and fighting the Army of Light. Having trained at the [[Sith academy]] on [[Sith Academy (Korriban)|Korriban]], these Sith Lords had demonstrated their potential early on, lest they be dispatched to a lesser academy elsewhere in the galaxy. After achieving their rank, Sith Lords would siege [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] and claim them for the Brotherhood and themselves. Collectively, Lord Kaan considered them the greatest asset of the Brotherhood in its war against the Jedi.<ref name="PoD" />

===Military===
Like most armies, the Brotherhood of Darkness had a clear and defined structure, ranging from powerful Sith Lords to the lowliest infantryman. In the leadership position, Sith Lords commanded various parts of the army, assisted by specialized Sith adepts who received training at various academies across Sith-controlled space.

[[Sith acolyte/Legends|Sith adepts and acolytes]] were apprentices who had only just begun to receive instruction in the ways of the dark side. They trained under more experienced Sith at the [[Sith Academy (Dathomir)|Dathomir Academy]] and the [[Sith Academy (Iridonia)|Iridonia Academy]]. [[Sith assassin/Legends|Sith assassins]] and [[Sith spy|spies]], whose primary purpose was to kill or capture Jedi, turned over their captives to high-ranking Sith Lords who would torture them until they either died or fell to the dark side and joined the Brotherhood. The assassins and spies were trained at the academies on [[Sith Academy (Ryloth)|Ryloth]], [[Sith Academy (Umbara)|Umbara]], and [[Sith Academy (Nar Shaddaa)|Nar Shaddaa]].<ref name="PoD" /> In the field, [[Sith Warrior]]s and [[Sith Marauder|Marauders]] focused on combat and led [[Sith trooper (New Sith Wars)|infantrymen]] into battle. They were trained to fight the Jedi on [[Sith Academy (Honoghr)|Honoghr]], [[Sith Academy (Gentes)|Gentes]], and [[Sith Academy (Gamorr)|Gamorr]].<ref name="PoD" />

[[Sith trooper (New Sith Wars)|The infantry]] was made up of non-Forceful beings and formed the bulk of the army. They were divided into units composed of four [[Squad/Legends|squads]], each containing a [[TC-17]]-equipped sniper and an [[interference box]]. They had their own officers in charge, but they were under the overall command of a Sith Lord. One such unit was the [[Gloom Walkers]], under the jurisdiction of Sith Lord [[Kopecz]].<ref name="PoD" />

==History==
===Formation===
{{Quote|Kaan was a traitor. He led the Brotherhood away from the teachings of the ancient Sith. He turned his back on the very essence of the dark side.|Darth Bane|<ref name="Darth Bane: Rule of Two" />}}
For nearly a thousand years, the Sith had been organized into the [[New Sith]] of [[Darth Ruin/Legends|Darth Ruin]]; waging a [[New Sith Wars|centuries-long war]] against the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], [[Republic Dark Age|nearly toppling both]]. Countless [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]] staked their claim across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], establishing territories from the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] until they began to encroach on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Galactic Core]]. As the Republic crumbled, members of the Jedi Order deemed themselves [[Jedi Lord]]s and took control of their own territories, holding back the Sith Empire's Coreward approach.<ref name="EGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>

In a naive attempt to end the war through politics, the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] raised their protégé [[Skere Kaan]] to the rank of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]]. An extremist and a radical, Kaan left the Order on his belief that it had brought suffering upon the galaxy through its failure to act and rallied his followers together to form the Brotherhood of Darkness. As the schism of [[1010 BBY]] rocked the Order, Kaan and his Brotherhood announced to the Republic and Jedi leadership that they would [[Sith civil war|take control]] of the remaining Sith enclaves as part of a scheme to reform the Republic. Within a few brief months, Kaan and his followers had crushed the most feared Sith Lords and taken their worlds as their own.<ref name="EGTW" />

===War with the Jedi===
As the Brotherhood of Darkness consolidated its newly conquered worlds, Kaan declared war on the Republic and gave himself the title [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]]. Despite his apparent leadership position, Kaan was forced to cede some power to the more powerful of his followers and rivals: [[Qordis]] and [[Kopecz]]. Under the banner that "All are equal in the Brotherhood of Darkness," Kaan organized a new [[Sith Council (Brotherhood of Darkness)|Sith Council]] and bestowed the title of Dark Lord upon each of its members. Under the "[[Rule by the Strong]]," Kaan and his followers set about to topple the Jedi and the Republic and create a [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark-side]] dictatorship.<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>

In order to destroy the Republic and the Jedi, even at their weakened state, the Brotherhood needed to amass a huge army. At [[Sith academy|academies]] across the galaxy, [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]] were trained to become fearsome [[Sith Warrior|warriors]], [[Sith assassin/Legends|assassins]] and [[Sith spy|spies]], while only the best came to serve at the [[Sith Academy (Korriban)|Sith Academy]] on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]]. Under the tutelage of Headmaster [[Qordis]], [[Sith acolyte/Legends|acolytes]] such as [[Githany]] and [[Darth Bane/Legends|Bane]] came to know the Force and learned to unleash their hatred and passions through its use. Needing more than Force-sensitives, the Brotherhood recruited commoners to form a massive army of infantrymen that would clear the path for the Sith warriors or subjugate worlds to strike fear into the heart of the region. Over the course of nine years, the Brotherhood amassed an army of over twenty thousand Sith, and finally Lord Kaan and the Brotherhood were ready to take on the severely weakened Republic.<ref name="NEC" />

War with the Republic did not come without cost or opposition. As Kaan left the Jedi Order in 1010 BBY, the weary [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] [[Battlemaster/Legends|battlemaster]] [[Hoth (Jedi Lord)|Hoth]] rallied the banners of the [[Jedi Grand Council]] to form the [[Army of Light/Legends|Army of Light]]. Under [[Jedi Lord|Lord]] Hoth's leadership, the Army of Light harried the Brotherhood of Darkness along its edges, careful to avoid striking at Kaan or other leaders during the first few years of conflict. Making his way across the Outer Rim, Hoth and the Army of Light liberated countless worlds from Sith control, weakening the Brotherhood while strengthening his own troops for a final confrontation.<ref name="EGTW" />

===The Ruusan Campaign===
Marshaling all his forces on the planet [[Ruusan/Legends|Ruusan]], Lord Kaan prepared to destroy Lord Hoth's forces with the full might of the Brotherhood's army. Despite his ambitious goals and the Brotherhood's once strong horde, Hoth and the Army of Light's tactics of drawing out the conflict took its toll. The Brotherhood's army had suffered major losses, and the fleet was in ruins. As Sith Lords were struck down over the course of seven battles during the [[Ruusan campaign]], the Brotherhood's numbers were reduced to only a tenth of their former number.<ref name="NEC" />

As the future grew dim for the Sith Council, an unlikely ally stepped forward to help. A former acolyte from Korriban named [[Darth Bane/Legends|Bane]] arrived on Ruusan with a proposal for Kaan: unleash a [[Telekinesis/Legends|wave of telekinetic]] energy to wipe out the Jedi's forces. Gathering behind Bane's plan, the Brotherhood's leadership met on a cliff overlooking the Jedi camp and, using Bane as a conduit, [[Sixth Battle of Ruusan|unleashed]] the power of the Force on the Army of Light. Working effectively, Kaan decided to end the ceremony early and defeat the Jedi and their army in a more conventional, hand-to-hand style. This decision would prove costly however; while the Sith claimed victory at the battle, in truth they wound up stalemated against the Jedi and the Army of Light.<ref name="PoD" />

Enraged at the frailty of the Brotherhood's leadership, Bane moved quickly to ensure the ultimate destruction of the Brotherhood. Contacting the [[Sith fleet (New Sith Wars)|Sith's fleet]] in orbit, he ordered it to engage the Jedi reinforcements despite knowing that they would then be able to slip [[Dropship/Legends|dropships]] past the [[Blockade/Legends|blockade]]. The Jedi caught the Sith off guard by attacking them, leading to the Sith losing numbers and being forced to retreat. When Kaan returned to his camp, Bane confronted him and deceptively advised him to unleash a [[thought bomb]] to annihilate the Jedi Order once and for all. Bane provided him the instructions to a thought bomb, which would destroy every [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force user]] within the radius upon use, but deceived Kaan into believing that the Brotherhood would survive the effects. On the brink of insanity and unaware of Bane's deception, Kaan agreed and together with the Sith Council, began to plan his masterstroke which would end the war, unaware that Bane was leading him and the Brotherhood to their demise.<ref name="PoD" />

During the [[Seventh Battle of Ruusan|seventh battle]] of the campaign, Kaan's forces who were in near defeat, marched into a cave system to produce the bomb. With all of his army inside, Kaan and his Council of Lords prepared the weapon while his loyal troops defended them from the Army of Light, which had followed them inside. As the bomb took form, the Sith Lords lost control of the monstrous weapon which they had created and were unable to prevent it from detonating before their escape. In a terrific detonation, the thought bomb's vicious energy was unleashed, draining the [[Force essence]] from all within the caves and sealing it within a void for all eternity. In one instant, the entire Brotherhood of the Sith and one hundred Jedi of the Army of Light's forces were vanquished.<ref name="PoD" />

===Legacy===
Darth Bane's [[Order of the Sith Lords]] and [[Rule of Two/Legends|Rule of Two]] would succeed the Brotherhood, and would last far longer, until [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], when it was overthrown by a redeemed [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and a victorious [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] in the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. [[Jerec (Inquisitor)|Jerec]], a former [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitor]], tried unsuccessfully to use the [[Valley of the Jedi]] (the former Ruusan battlefield) for his own gain and was killed by [[Kyle Katarn]] a year after. In [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]], [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] resurrected himself through a clone and attempted to reclaim the Empire, and met his end trying to possess Darth Vader's grandson after his supplies needed to survive in a possessed cloned body were destroyed by subversives in his inner circle. Though the Brotherhood was gone, others such as [[Darth Millennial]] and perhaps even the [[One Sith]] of [[Darth Krayt]] would imitate its policy, though the One Sith had just one Dark Lord. A former member of the Brotherhood, [[Vulta Daanat]], created a cult called the [[Blackguard (Mustafar)/Legends|Blackguard]] and passed down the teachings of the Brotherhood to its members.
